assessment_objectives.objective: an executive steering committee, or advisory board, evaluates business practices for possible forced exfiltration of sensitive / regulated information (e.g., Intellectual Property (IP)) to a host government for purposes of market access or market management practices.

documented measures enable the executive steering committee, or advisory board, to identify and evaluate host nation business practices that could result in the forced exfiltration of sensitive / regulated information (e.g., Intellectual Property (IP)) to the host government for purposes of market access or market management practices.

actions are taken to prevent and/or block potential instances that enable the forced exfiltration of sensitive / regulated information (e.g., Intellectual Property (IP)) to the host government for purposes of market access or market management practices.
